Our new organic cotton is a natural fibre and should be washed with care:

Meet the Classic Zip Through Hoodie. Cut from premium heavyweight 100% organic cotton, our signature Classic sweat fabric is designed with a thicker weight for added comfort. Featuring a roomy hood and finished with branding on the chest. Style yours with the matching sweatpants for an effortless look. Ease into the new season with our new Classic Hoodie.


→ 100% Organic Cotton
→ 440GSM - heavy weight
→ Relaxed fit
→ Marshmallow white Adanola Sport branding on chest left hand side
→ Full zip


How to care for your organic cotton sweats.

Our new organic cotton is a natural fibre and should be washed with care:

→ Wash cold, on a gentle setting - do not wash on a hot cycle as the natural fibres will warp and reduce in size
→ Avoid using fabric conditioner - it clogs the pores causing the fabric to lose their natural softness
→ Gently reshape when wet
→ Lay flat to dry & make sure to remove from the washer promptly
→ Iron on a warm temp to remove any creases

products.title: Funnel Neck Balloon Sleeve Down Puffer Jacket - Storm Blue
products.body_html:
New outerwear has landed. Crafted with premium down fill, this puffer jacket offers warmth and insulation against the cold. Designed with a funnel neck, exaggerated balloon sleeves and ribbed cuffs for added protection, it’s finished with a screen-printed logo at the left sleeve for a signature touch.


→ 100% Nylon
→ Down Insulation: 650 fill duck down (minimum 90% down)
→ Water repellent: ISO Spray Rating Level 4
→ Excellent wind proofing against wind, significantly reducing wind chill
→ Lightweight: 165g to 186g across sizes
→ Breathable real duck down insulation
→ Taped seams to keep dry
→ Elasticated hem & hidden rib detail cuffs providing additional warmth
→ Contrast black zip
→ Screen-printed logo on arm
→ Tonal branded rubber badge on centre back


Take good care of me:

→ Wash inside out
→ Wash on a gentle setting
→ Wash on low temperature, no more than 30 degrees
→ Rinse after washing
→ Do not tumble dry, twist or wring the product out
→ Air-dry and shake out to keep the down evenly distributed
